name: add-platform
title: Add Platform
description: Add a platform to an existing Pixel Perfect project by running TARGET and EQUIP for that platform and recording its gated build state.
preservation: Preserve every selection, validation, and manifest gate

name: build
title: Build
description: Build a Pixel Perfect project through planning, atoms, molecules, organisms, screens, and integration using real components and required verification gates.
preservation: Do not summarize, replace, or stub any implementation, test, sandbox, or gate

name: design-deconstruct
title: Design Deconstruct
description: Deconstruct UI code, URLs, screenshots, concepts, or HTML into a token-governed atomic design system and real target-framework components when configured.
preservation: Load the bundled deconstruct-engine and preserve every preflight, render, token, coverage, and audit gate

name: evolve
title: Evolve
description: Evolve a Pixel Perfect design system inventory — absorb a new screen or mock, extend an entity, promote a repeated pattern, or shed a screen with an orphan sweep, proved by catalog capture.
preservation: Confirm the full delta before any write or delete; hand additions to build; prove with re-capture; never silent-duplicate or silent-sweep

name: init
title: Init
description: Initialize a Pixel Perfect project through DISCOVER, TARGET, and EQUIP, capturing goal, platforms, framework, styling, libraries, and sandbox choices.
preservation: Preserve every discovery, selection, validation, and manifest gate

name: refine
title: Refine
description: Refine Pixel Perfect components, screens, or theme from targeted feedback, update real code, and rerun the affected verification gates.
preservation: Do not substitute mockups or placeholders for requested product changes

name: research
title: Research
description: Research UI patterns, competitors, trends, or ecosystem libraries and save evidence-backed findings into the project's design research library.
preservation: Use current sources and preserve every required evidence field and output

name: scaffold
title: Scaffold
description: Scaffold a Pixel Perfect project by installing selected tools, creating the theme and sandbox, generating token stories, and verifying a real hello-world component.
preservation: Preserve every installation, render, and verification gate

name: status
title: Status
description: Inspect and report a Pixel Perfect project's current phase, gate status, component coverage, sandbox state, and next required action.
preservation: Report actual state without inventing progress

name: verify
title: Verify
description: Run Pixel Perfect verification gates for the current phase, report concrete evidence, and advance only when every required check passes.
preservation: Never fake evidence, weaken a gate, or report a partial check as complete

name: wireframe
title: Wireframe
description: Generate low-fidelity ASCII wireframes from plans, targets, specs, or concepts as governed structural input to higher-fidelity work.
preservation: Produce the complete required wireframe set, states, annotations, and mappings
